_comment: Owls hunt small animals and birds (Hedwig goes out hunting at night in Philosopher's Stone; Minecraft has no mice, so rabbit and chicken stand in). Numbers copied from hippogriff.json, the nearest shipped profile (a meat-eating bird that sheds feathers): same gains, cooldowns, follow threshold, milestones, proximity and betrayal. Its fish and beef feeds were dropped as not owl prey. The gift is the hippogriff's feather, here the quill a wizard writes with.
